name: ai-usage-monitor
description: Shows token usage, model, duration and verified cost for every AI request.

commands.title: AI Usage: Export History as JSON
AI Usage: Export History as CSV
AI Usage: Copy Ingest Endpoint Snippet

aiUsageMonitor.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the latest request's usage in the status bar.

aiUsageMonitor.history.maxEntries.description: How many requests to keep in the local history.

aiUsageMonitor.sources.enabled.markdownDescription: Automatically track AI tools installed on this machine by reading the usage records they already write to disk. Read-only: nothing is sent anywhere, and prompt and response text is never read. Run `AI Usage: Show Detected Tools` to see what was found.

aiUsageMonitor.sources.disabled.markdownDescription: Source ids to skip, e.g. `["claude-code"]`. Everything detected is tracked unless listed here.

aiUsageMonitor.sources.backfillDays.markdownDescription: How many days of existing history to import when tracking starts. `0` records only new requests. Large values on a machine with long history will take a moment to scan.

aiUsageMonitor.ingest.enabled.description: Run a loopback HTTP endpoint that accepts usage metadata from your own tools and proxies (e.g. a LiteLLM callback).

aiUsageMonitor.ingest.port.description: Port for the loopback ingest endpoint. Bound to 127.0.0.1 only.

aiUsageMonitor.pricing.custom.markdownDescription: Verified pricing per model, in USD per 1M tokens. Cost is only ever shown for models listed here or in the built-in verified table; these entries take precedence over it. Keys: `input`, `output` (both required), and the optional `cachedInput`, `cacheWrite`, `contextWindow`. An omitted rate counts as unverified, not as zero — a request billing that token class will show no cost rather than a partial one. Use the exact model id your provider reports, including any `anthropic.` or `@date` prefix. Example: `{ "my-model": { "input": 3, "output": 15, "cachedInput": 0.3 } }`

scripts.vsix: npm run verify && npm run package && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
